protocol.json.content_text:
{
  "study": "RIPII conditional hierarchy coupling study v1",
  "status": "prospectively_written_development_protocol",
  "hypothesis": "Learned hierarchy is useful only when nonlocal interactions require structured global communication beyond a pooled global context.",
  "h0": "Coupling does not give multiscale a >=5 percentage-point paired advantage over the global-pool control on larger-object scenes.",
  "h1": "For every seed, coupled-regime multiscale improves more-objects position RMSE over global-pool by >=5%, and that relative improvement exceeds its local-regime value by >=5 percentage points.",
  "decision_rule": "all paired seed conditions in H1 must pass",
  "models": [
    "graph",
    "global_pool",
    "multiscale"
  ],
  "bottleneck": "continuous",
  "seeds": [
    53,
    59,
    61
  ],
  "regimes": {
    "local": 0.0,
    "coupled": 1.0
  },
  "experiment_without_coupling": {
    "steps": 100,
    "train_scenes": 96,
    "eval_scenes": 16,
    "train_horizon": 16,
    "test_horizon": 32,
    "rollout_steps": 4,
    "batch_size": 32,
    "hidden": 44,
    "max_objects": 8,
    "lr": 0.001,
    "data_seed": 12031,
    "validate_every": 25,
    "quantizer_weight": 0.01,
    "global_coupling": 0.0
  },
  "git": {
    "commit": "fdcf2de8e8f24caa569df1bbf891365233ca00d0",
    "dirty": true
  },
  "limitations": [
    "development study, not externally preregistered",
    "one synthetic simulator and one data seed",
    "parameter matched but not FLOP matched",
    "small seed count gives low-resolution inference"
  ]
}
